# LSD.Law

> > The comprehensive platform for law school admissions data, rankings, and application tracking with real outcomes from 1M+ applicants.

LSD.Law is the leading resource for prospective law students, providing detailed admissions statistics, school comparisons, and live decision tracking across all 295 ABA-accredited law schools. The platform combines official ABA 509 data with crowdsourced application outcomes to help students make informed enrollment decisions.

## Key Topics

- Law School Admissions
- LSAT Scores
- GPA Requirements
- T14 Schools
- Law School Rankings
- Acceptance Rates
- Admissions Statistics
- Application Outcomes
- School Comparisons
- Cross-Admit Data
- Scholarship Offers
- Application Tracker
- Status Checker
- ABA 509 Data
- Soft Factors

## Law School Rankings & Comparisons

- [2025 Best Law School Rankings — Top Law Schools Compared](https://lsd.law/law-school-rankings): Compare law schools with rankings, LSAT/GPA stats, and employment outcomes
- [All ABA Law Schools - Rankings, Data & Stats](https://lsd.law/schools): Browse 295 ABA-accredited law schools with admissions data and comparisons
- [Law School Comparisons 2026 - Cross-Admit Data & Side-by-Side Stats](https://lsd.law/compare): Compare 393 law school pairs with real cross-admit data and statistics
- [ABA 509 Data: Compare Law School LSAT, GPA & Acceptance Rates](https://lsd.law/law-school-lsat-gpa-gre): Official ABA 509 admissions data comparison tool for all law schools

## Admissions Tools & Predictors

- [Free Law School Admissions Predictor & Chance Calculator](https://lsd.law/law-school-chances-predictor): Calculate law school admission chances using LSAT and GPA scores
- [Law School Applicant Search — Real Outcomes by LSAT & GPA](https://lsd.law/applicant-search): Search 1M law school application outcomes by test scores and school
- [Recent Law School Decisions & Admission Waves — Live Tracker](https://lsd.law/recent-decisions): Live tracker of law school admissions decisions from 150K+ applicants
- [Automated Status Checker](https://lsd.law/features/status-checker): Automated tool for tracking law school application status updates

## Legal Education Resources

- [Case Briefs - Free Legal Case Summaries & IRAC Analysis](https://briefs.lsd.law): Access 53,000+ free case briefs with IRAC analysis for law students
- [Simple Legal Definitions & Plain English Law Dictionary](https://definitions.lsd.law): Plain English legal dictionary with clear definitions of legal terms
- [Law School Soft Tiers Guide](https://lsd.law/softs): Guide to understanding soft factors in law school admissions evaluation

## Financial Planning

- [Student Loan Refinancing Calculator](https://lsd.law/loan-calculator): Calculator for comparing student loan refinancing options and savings

## Data & Research

- [Get the Data](https://lsd.law/download): Download anonymized law school admissions data and research datasets
